environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)
environment.pacing: GT4_PACING unset or paced (default): paced clock. GT4_PACING=audio: blocking WinMM clock as in slice152. The launcher refuses other values and records both names in result.json (pacing_environment).

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: O4 frame pacing candidate: gs-async (VU1 AOT plus asynchronous GS) with one wall-clock guest VBlank grid at 60 Hz (donor frame_cycles = kEeClock / 60), non-blocking audio with a 60 ms ring target and +-0.5 percent resample rate control. GT4_PACING=audio restores the blocking audio clock for A/B. Headless emulation is unpaced and unchanged.
preserved_inputs: Production EE library, donor 1b48087 runtime capsule (slice151 VU1 AOT overlay), slice152 adapter and nine shaders copied byte-identical into private/slice153-pacing-port and private/slice153-pacing-shaders; slice151/152 build directories untouched.

controls.ctest: CTest 18/18 on private/slice153-pacing-build/build (native_pacing: pacer grid, stall handling, resampler identity and sine accuracy, rate controller convergence, saturation and jitter, ring, histogram, windows, diagnostics format; host_io_fixture: real WinMM audio plus a 3 s paced device run).
controls.python: Python 217 tests OK with GT4_NATIVE_BUILD set to the slice153 build; one pre-existing skip.
controls.headless_smoke: 4200 frames, 12-press schedule (600:start:30, then 900-3900 every 300), no window: 42 frame dumps (every 100) identical to the slice152 async build. Headless runs never call the window paced path.
controls.present_forwarding: GT4_PRESENT_MODE=mailbox forwarded to the native host and logged ("present mode request: mailbox"); recorded as pacing_environment in result.json.
controls.not_run: No window or gameplay session was launched by the implementing agent; owner measurement is required.

limits: Pacing constants: 60 Hz guest grid; 60 ms audio target (2880 frames); 16 x 256-frame WinMM buffers; 16384-frame ring; device at most 2816 frames; resample ratio within +-0.5 percent; proportional gain 0.03, integral gain 0.002.

Start-up transient (measured with the host fixture on the real device): the device starts about two guest frames after first submission, so the queue peaks near 4500 frames (about 95 ms) and returns to the target in roughly 8 s at the +-0.5 percent authority. No underrun was observed.
FIFO presentation blocks on the monitor refresh. On a 60.000 Hz monitor the grid and presents align; on a 59.94 Hz panel presents back up and can add stalls (speed effect unmeasured).
A frame that overruns its period is counted late and the grid restarts one period after the late release; no guest frame is skipped and the clock is not raised.
Diagnostics print only with GT4_PERF=1 (the F7/F8 probe); the histogram is recorded in both pacing modes.
Shutdown in paced mode drains only the device queue; the ring remainder (under 60 ms) is discarded.
Owner gameplay frame measurements (median, p95, p99, speed) are not yet taken. The O4 targets are not claimed.

review.note: Owner gameplay, frame timing and overlay checks not run; local headless, CTest and Python evidence only.
